top_candidates.name: Craft
top_candidates.rationale: Single word, professional, evokes the care and expertise of craftsmanship. Directly opposes commoditization. Easy to spell, memorable, strong metaphor for quality work.
top_candidates.domain_status: craft.com available but premium ($15k+); craft.io, craft.dev available
top_candidates.trademark_risk: Craft is used in many industries; recommend full trademark search

top_candidates.name: Faire
top_candidates.approach: Semantic - French for 'make' or 'do', evokes fairness
top_candidates.rationale: Sophisticated and international. Double meaning: 'faire' (French) and resembles 'fair'. Professional tone. Two syllables. Suggests craftsmanship and equity.
top_candidates.trademark_risk: Low; French origin may aid distinctiveness

top_candidates.name: Nexus
top_candidates.rationale: Professional, networking connotation. Strong metaphor for partnerships and connections. Memorable, authoritative. Two syllables.
top_candidates.domain_status: nexus.com not available; nexus.io, nexus.co available
top_candidates.trademark_risk: Moderate; used in tech and other industries

top_candidates.name: Merit
top_candidates.approach: Semantic - evokes deserved value and quality
top_candidates.rationale: Single word, strongly evokes fair compensation and recognition of excellence. Professional, authoritative. Clear opposition to race-to-the-bottom pricing.
top_candidates.trademark_risk: Low; generic term used infrequently as brand

top_candidates.name: Provenance
top_candidates.approach: Semantic - evokes authenticity, expertise, and origin
top_candidates.rationale: Sophisticated, evokes quality and proven expertise. Slightly longer (3 syllables) but highly distinctive. Professional and trustworthy tone.
top_candidates.trademark_risk: Low; generic term with historical association

scoring_methodology: Candidates scored 0-100 against each naming criteria: partnership/fairness (emotional fit), memorable/spelling (accessibility), domain availability (practical), neutral/cultural (global readiness), not trendy (timelessness), single word (simplicity). Overall score is weighted average (40% emotional fit, 20% accessibility, 20% availability, 20% timelessness).
domain_availability_summary: craft.com premium ($15k+); faire.com available for $15/year; nexus.com taken; merit.com available; provenance.com available. Strong .io and .co alternatives available for all top 5. Recommendation: pursue faire.com or merit.com on .com; otherwise .io is professional and acceptable.
trademark_flags: Craft - used in multiple industries, requires full USPTO search
Nexus - used in tech and industries, requires search
Guild - used in some games/communities, search recommended
recommendation: Top choice: Faire (strong positioning on fairness, available domain, international appeal, low trademark risk). Second choice: Merit (strong domain availability, clear value proposition). Both strongly reinforce the Sage archetype and white space positioning. Recommend proceeding with full trademark searches and domain registration for top 2, then conducting stakeholder feedback before final selection.
